correctness.rationale: Cauchy projection gives R_N=(1/sqrt N) sum |a_i|. Every section k-face crosses a (k+1)-simplex face, so f_{N,k}=binom(N,k+2)-binom(K,k+2)-binom(N-K,k+2). Under centered Gaussian directions, the shadow influence |G|-mu-(mu/2)(G²-1) is even and the centered sign influence sgn(G)-mu G is odd; their CLT limits are independent. Fixed-k polynomial expansion gives D_{N,k}=S_N²/[2^{k+2}k! N]+o_p(1). Shadow moment identities follow from spherical coordinate moments; finite experiments support but do not prove the limit.
residual_risks: Finite cases do not prove unrestricted claim; the symbolic/mathematical argument is assessed separately.
